'''Irina Borysivna Ivshina''' (born 12 June 12, 1950, [[Perm, Russia]]) is a  Russian [[microbiologist]]. She is head of the Laboratory of Alcanotrophic Microorganisms of the Institute of Ecology and Genetics of Microorganisms (IEGM).<ref>{{Cite web|last=Vasilyeva|first=Nataliya|date=2012-01-01|title=Rampant oil leaks in Russia tragically routine|url=https://www.sfgate.com/business/article/Rampant-oil-leaks-in-Russia-tragically-routine-2434904.php|access-date=2020-12-30|website=SFGATE|language=en-US}}</ref>

She is a professor at the [[Perm State University]]. She is vice-president of the Russian Microbiological Society.<ref>{{Cite book|last1=Bakloushinskaya|first1=Irina Yurʹevna|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=GlTwAAAAMAAJ&q=Irina+Ivshina|title=Vorontsov's Who's who in Biodiversity Sciences: In Azerbaijan, Armenia, Belarus, Estonia, Georgia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Russia, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan|last2=Minter|first2=D. W.|date=2001|publisher=KMK Scientific Press|isbn=9785873170920|language=en}}</ref> She was an editor for [[Molecules (journal)|''Molecules''.]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Molecules|url=https://www.mdpi.com/journal/molecules/special_issues/Biologically_Agents_Polycyclic_Biocatalytic_Chemical_Approaches|access-date=2020-12-30|website=www.mdpi.com|language=en}}</ref>
